business_summary: Beekay Steel Industries Limited manufactures and sells steel products for the railway, infrastructure, housing, automobile, and engineering sectors in India. The company offers flat, round, square, round corner square, hexagonal, octagonal, and trapezium sections. It also provides flat, round, square, and hexagonal bright bars, which are cold drawn/ground/peeled plain bars produced from hot rolled plain bars/wire rods; structural hot rolled steel products, such as angles, channels, I-beams, and H-beams forms; spring steel; thermo-mechanically treated (TMT) bars; and crane rails, as well as sponge iron. The company exports its products to Saudi Arabia, the United Arabs Emirates, Australia, the Netherlands, Myanmar, and Bahrain. Beekay Steel Industries Limited was founded in 1974 and is based in Kolkata, India.
